summary.headline: Astrological Beginnings and Climacterics
summary.text: Mars’ zodiacal contacts with Jupiter, Saturn, the Sun, and Moon predict benefits, honors, and climacteric dangers through the 45th year. “On Beginnings” gives astrological rules for Tuesday and Saturday hours, stars near sign beginnings and the ascendant, attributed to Mougnes, Embrenios, and the ancients.
